definitions: A book, often part of a series, that has been specially written or adapted for language learners, with the vocabulary and grammar controlled to suit different levels of proficiency.
A simplified text designed for people learning a foreign language, with the number of words and the complexity of sentences restricted to a particular level.
examples: She started with a beginner-level graded reader.
Many publishers offer extensive collections of graded readers.
The graded reader helped him improve his English vocabulary.
